title: Local Well-Posedness of Lovelock Equations
exact_target: Establish a locally well-posed initial-value theory for Lovelock gravitational equations.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 30002921 (OWR-13854-006). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.
Mathematical Aspects of General Relativity (2015), Oberwolfach Reports, DOI 10.4171/owr/2015/33, pp. 1867--1935. Primary report accessed 2026-10-11; relevant PDF pages 38.
Papallo--Reall, local well-posedness of Lovelock theories (catalogue-listed context; not independently consulted in this preparation).
Kovacs--Reall, well-posed Lovelock formulation (catalogue-listed context; not independently consulted in this preparation).

status_qualification: The spacetime dimension, coupling constants, branch and data regime are not fixed by the extracted sentence. They must be specified in a theorem; local well-posedness on one branch cannot be presented as a result for all Lovelock data.
